Du arbeitest an Landingpages, Kampagnen und unserer Conversion-Optimierung mit. Du erstellst und optimierst Content für LinkedIn, Website und weitere Kanäle. Du analysierst die Performance unserer Marketingmaßnahmen und leitest gemeinsam mit uns Verbesserungen ab. Du unterstützt bei CRM, Outreach und Follow-ups. Du bringst eigene Ideen für neue Marketingmaßnahmen und Experimente ein und hilfst dabei, diese umzusetzen. Du übernimmst zunehmend eigenständig kleinere Marketingprojekte. Du studierst aktuell, z. B. BWL, Marketing, Kommunikation, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du kannst ein 6-monatiges Pflichtpraktikum absolvieren oder suchst ein freiwilliges Praktikum von bis zu 3 Monaten. Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig und findest dich schnell in neue Themen ein. Du interessierst dich für Marketing, Startups, Technologie und KI. Du hast Spaß daran, Dinge auszuprobieren, Ergebnisse zu messen und daraus zu lernen. Du kannst dich schriftlich und mündlich sehr gut auf Deutsch ausdrücken. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jeder einzelne Schritt vorgegeben wird. Erste Erfahrungen mit Canva, Google Ads, Google Analytics, HubSpot, LinkedIn oder KI-Tools sind hilfreich – aber keine Voraussetzung. Du kannst eigene Ideen ausprobieren und unmittelbar sehen, welche Wirkung sie haben. Moderne KI- und Software-Tools gehören bei uns zum normalen Arbeitsalltag. Kurze Entscheidungswege, wenig Hierarchie und viel Raum zum Mitdenken. Unser Office befindet sich auf dem Areal Böhler in Meerbusch. Du musst noch nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du neugierig bist, schnell lernst und Lust hast, gemeinsam mit uns Dinge auszuprobieren und besser zu machen. title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)
description: Dein Herz schlägt für visuelles Marketing und du hast Freude daran, wenn deine Kunden mit deiner Hilfe sichtbar besser werden? Dann unterstütze unsere Mission und mache professionelles Video-Marketing für jeden zugänglich. Aufgaben Onboarding: Du begleitest neue Kunden (Makler, Immobilienfotografen, Bauträger) von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zum ersten begeisternden Video – inklusive Setup, Anbindung und Schulung des Teams. Betreuung & Adoption: Du bist die persönliche Ansprechpartnerin bzw. der persönliche Ansprechpartner Deiner Kunden. Du behältst im Blick, wie aktiv sie unsere Software nutzen, gehst proaktiv auf sie zu und holst stille Accounts zurück ins Boot. Beratung: Du zeigst nicht nur, welche Buttons man klickt, sondern wie ein Video wirklich verkauft – von der Fotoauswahl bis zur Ausspielung auf Instagram, in der Portalanzeige oder im Exposé. Expansion & Renewal: Du erkennst, wann ein Kunde bereit für mehr ist, sicherst Vertragsverlängerungen und entwickelst Accounts weiter (Upselling, weitere Standorte, weitere Nutzer). Produktentwicklung: Du hörst genau hin, was der Markt braucht, und gibst das Feedback der Makler direkt an unser Entwicklerteam weiter. Skalierung: Du baust mit uns die Basis auf, mit der wir viele Kunden gleichzeitig glücklich machen: Hilfe-Artikel, Tutorial-Videos, Webinare und smarte Prozesse. Qualifikation Service-Mindset: Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern verstehen, was Dein Kunde eigentlich erreichen will – und greifst dafür auch gerne selbst zum Hörer. Digitale Affinität: Du musst kein Programmierer sein, aber Du solltest Dich sicher in Web-Apps bewegen und verstehen, warum Video-Content auf Instagram & Co. heute essenziell ist. Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst zuhören, zwischen den Zeilen lesen und komplexe Dinge einfach erklären – auch am Telefon mit Menschen, die nicht digital aufgewachsen sind. Dein Deutsch ist exzellent in Wort und Schrift. Erfahrung: Idealerweise hast Du bereits im Customer Success, Account Management, Support oder in der Immobilienbranche gearbeitet. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies. Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha. At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way. Your mission You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions. Your profile You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university. You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro). You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals. You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop. You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it. You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required. How we work We are an AI-powered development team . Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write. Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you. Potential Research Directions These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads. 1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot. 2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data. 3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several. Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship. Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions. Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on. AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly. Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively. Interested? Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you! raw.title: (Senior) Talent Acquisition Manager (m/w/d)
raw.description:
Warum diese Rolle?

GovRadar ist eine cloudbasierte Software zur automatisierten Erstellung öffentlicher Ausschreibungsunterlagen. Mit unserer KI-gestützten Lösung sparen Behörden bis zu 90% Zeit in der Vergabevorbereitung, damit Investitionen schneller in die Umsetzung kommen.

Wir befähigen die öffentliche Verwaltung – für eine zukunftssichere Gesellschaft.


Deine Mission

Als (Senior) Talent Acquisition Manager bist du die treibende Kraft zur zielgerichteten Erweiterung unseres Teams und spielst damit eine entscheidende Rolle für unser zukünftiges Wachstum. Du bist Teil des CEO Office und für Kandidaten, wie auch unsere Hiring Manager, die zentrale Ansprechperson im gesamten Recruiting Prozess.
Für diese Herausforderungen brauchen wir dich:

  • Verantwortung des end-to-end Recruiting-Prozesses, von Hiring Strategie über Stellenausschreibung und Pipeline Management bis zur Vertragsunterschrift
  • Weiterentwicklung unseres Employer Branding, um GovRadar zur ersten Wahl für Top-Talente im GovTech-Sektor zu etablieren
  • Active Sourcing und Aufbau qualifizierter Talent-Pipelines für verschiedene Rollen in Product & Engineering, GTM und Operations
  • Sicherstellung einer effizienten und wertschätzenden Experience für Kandidaten und Hiring Manager
  • Koordinierung von externen Stakeholdern, wie z.B. Headhunter für ausgewählte Positionen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von skalierbaren Prozessen mit dem richtigen Mix aus AI/Automatisierung und Human Touch


Dein Profil

Must have’s

  • Kommunikationsstärke in Deutsch (min. C1) und professioneller Umgang auf Englisch (min. B2)
  • Mindestens 3-4 Jahre Erfahrung im Active Sourcing & Recruiting mit end-to-end Prozess-Verantwortung und erfolgreicher Zusammenarbeit mit Senior Leadership / C-Level
  • Umgang mit Tech- & Business-Profilen: du bist nachweislich in der Lage, Kandidaten mit unterschiedlichsten Backgrounds zu begeistern, zu qualifizieren und mit ihnen auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren
  • Spaß am Arbeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld: du hast bereits in einem Startup gearbeitet und siehst schnelle Veränderungen und fehlende Strukturen als spannende Herausforderung
  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise: du kannst dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeiten, nimmst proaktiv Herausforderungen an und holst dir an den entsprechenden Stellen Unterstützung dazu
  • Daten- und Tech-Affinität: du steuerst deine Pipeline datengetrieben und suchst proaktiv nach Potentialen für Automatisierung/AI
  • Aufbau von Strukturen: du hast skalierbare Prozesse nicht nur angewendet, sondern bereits selbst von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung mitgestaltet
Nice to have’s
  • Talent Acquisition als neue Funktion von Grund auf aufgebaut & etabliert
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Teamtailor als ATS
  • Vernetzung im Münchner SaaS-Startup-Ökosystem
  • Berührungspunkte mit dem öffentlichen Sektor oder GovTech-Unternehmen


Was dich erwartet

  • Team & Kultur - ein hochmotiviertes, interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien
  • Gestaltungsfreiheit & Ownership - ein vielfältiges Aufgabengebiet und die Möglichkeit, eine neue Funktion nach deinen Ideen und Vorstellungen aufzubauen
  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung - ein attraktives Fixgehalt zuzüglich performance-basierter Boni, die deine Erfolge belohnen
  • Kontinuierliches Lernen - Weiterentwicklung als Teil deiner individuellen Ziele, unterstützt durch dezidiertes Budget und monatliches Coaching mit deiner Führungskraft
  • Flexibles Arbeiten - hybrides Modell (3 Tage im Büro direkt am Hauptbahnhof), flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeit auf Workation
  • Hohe Sichtbarkeit - du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Leadership Team an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation
  • Gesellschaftlicher Impact - trage aktiv dazu bei, den Staat in Deutschland handlungsfähiger zu machen und das Vertrauen der Menschen in die Demokratie zu stärken

title: Entwicklungsingenieur:in F&E | High-Tech Kompressor Startup
description: Wir machen Heizen und Kühlen radikal effizienter. Ecalia ist ein Deep-Tech-Startup aus Stuttgart, das die Kälte- und Wärmepumpentechnik grundlegend neu denkt. Unsere Innovation sind Scroll-Kompressor-Expander-Systeme, die mit konventionellen Kältemitteln arbeiten und den thermodynamischen Kreisprozess näher an das Optimum bringen als alle derzeit auf dem Markt verfügbaren Systeme. Damit adressieren wir einen der größten Hebel für globale Energieeffizienz, denn Heizung und Kühlung verbrauchen fast die Hälfte der weltweiten Energie. Wir wurden als eines der Top-10 innovativsten Tech-Startups Deutschlands ausgezeichnet (Weconomy Award 2025) und arbeitenam Institut für Kunststofftechnik der Universität Stuttgart an unseren Prototypen und Testanlagen. Wir sind ein kleines eingespieltes Team aus derzeit 4 Personen. Wir wachsen und legen Wert auf ein diverses und hochmotiviertes Team. Unser Anspruch ist es auch bisherige Geschäfts- und Entwicklungsprozesse neu zu denken und KI-Tools sukzessive in die Arbeitsabläufe zu integrieren und sie zu unserem primären Arbeitswerkzeug zu entwickeln. Startdatum: Ab November 2026. Aufgaben Du übernimmst einen Teil der Forschungs- und Entwicklungsarbeit , die aktuell unser CTO allein trägt, und arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Systemarchitektur und Werkstatt. Der CTO definiert die technische Richtung, du legst die Komponenten aus und bringst sie zur Baureife, unser Prototypenbau-Ingenieur baut sie. Dein Fokus: Physikalische Probleme oder Bedürfnisse in funktionierende Entwürfe überführen. Systematisch, KI-gestützt und auf hohem Qualitätsniveau. Konkret heißt das: Komponenten auslegen & dimensionieren: Du berechnest Scroll-Geometrien, Dichtungen, Druckbehälter, Wellen und Lager und stellst sicher, dass alles funktioniert. Designvarianten bewerten: Mehrere Lösungswege durchrechnen, vergleichen, dem CTO eine fundierte Empfehlung vorlegen. Dein Ingenieur:innen-Urteil zählt. Konstruieren: CAD-Entwürfe (Autodesk Inventor o.ä.) erstellen, die direkt in den Prototypenbau gehen. Baubar, fertigungsgerecht, durchdacht, und einfach anzupassen. Physikalische Probleme lösen: Verstehen was in unseren Scroll-Maschinen vor sich geht, und mit KI-Tools und Physik unsere Produkte weiterentwickeln. Ob Thermodynamik, Strömungsmechanik oder Festigkeit, du nutzt das Werkzeug, das am schnellsten zur belastbaren Antwort führt: Handrechnung, Python-Skript, Simulation oder Experiment. Wo dir Know-How fehlt, baust du dir KI Agenten die dich ergänzen. Versuche planen & Daten auswerten: Prüfstandsversuche systematisch designen (DoE), Messdaten analysieren, Schlussfolgerungen ziehen, Designiterationen ableiten. Systematisch entwickeln: Wir entwickeln KI-gestützt, aber nicht chaotisch. Du arbeitest nach klaren Strukturen. Berechnungen, Dokumentation und Ergebnisse werden zielgerichtet und nachvollziehbar abgelegt, nicht als lose Excel-Dateien irgendwo geparkt. Du steuerst die KI, korrigierst sie und stellst sicher, dass die Outputs unseren Qualitätsstandards entsprechen. Dafür brauchst du breites und tiefes Verständnis, um Ergebnisse bewerten zu können. Qualität leben & Nachweise führen: Druckfestigkeitsnachweise, Normenrecherche, technische Dokumentation nach strukturierten Prozessen. Perfekt definieren wir dabei als „dem Bedarf entsprechend" (Fit-for-Purpose), nicht „so gut es technisch möglich ist". Programmieren: Python für Berechnungen, Datenanalyse, Automatisierung. Code als Ingenieur:innen-Werkzeug. Du kannst in Prozessen denken und auch eigene Workflows mitaufbauen. KI als Arbeitswerkzeug nutzen: Recherche, Berechnung, Dokumentation, Code - KI ist bei uns kein Add-on, sondern integraler Bestandteil des Workflows. Du steuerst die KI, gibst die Richtung vor, prüfst kritisch und sorgst dafür, dass die Ergebnisse stimmen. Qualifikation Das brauchst du für deine neue Rolle Erfahrung in der Entwicklung physischer Produkte oder Komponenten: Der vollständige Weg von der Auslegung zum funktionierenden Entwurf. Physik-Fundament: Studium in Maschinenbau, Physik, Energietechnik oder vergleichbar. Du verstehst die Physik hinter den Formeln, kannst neue Zusammenhänge aus physikalischen Konzepten ableiten und das richtige Werkzeug wählen. CAD-Kompetenz: Du erstellst eigenständig Entwürfe, die in den Prototypenbau gehen (Autodesk Inventor oder vergleichbar). Programmierkenntnisse: Python oder eine vergleichbare Sprache für Berechnung und Auswertung ist Pflicht. Du denkst algorithmisch und kannst eigenständig Berechnungstools und Analysen entwickeln. KI-Kompetenz: KI ist fester Teil deines Workflows (Recherche, Berechnung, Dokumentation, Code). Du lernst proaktiv, wie man prompted (um keine Halluzinationen oder Bestätigungsfehler einzuladen) und weißt, wann du KI-Ergebnissen vertrauen kannst und wann nicht. Analytisches Denken: Du hinterfragst Annahmen, denkst von Grundprinzipien aus, und findest die einfachste Lösung, die funktioniert. Systematisches Arbeiten (Product Development Control): Du entwickelst nicht einfach drauflos, sondern arbeitest strukturiert - klare Dokumentation, nachvollziehbare Entscheidungen, zielgerichtete Ablage. Du verstehst, warum Prozesse in der Entwicklung existieren, und hast den Ehrgeiz, den richtigen Qualitätswinkel zu treffen (weder over-engineering noch schlampig). Auge fürs Detail: Korrekt, akkurat, mit Stolz auf die eigene Arbeit. Plausibilitätschecks sind für dich selbstverständlich. Streben nach Weiterentwicklung: Du bist reflektiert und verbesserst deine Arbeitsweise ständig, um dein volles Potenzial zu entfalten. ≥3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Produktentwicklung oder vergleichbarer Ingenieurtätigkeit. Deutsch fließend (Arbeitssprache). Das würden wir gerne sehen Erfahrung mit Kompressortechnik , idealerweise Scroll-Kompressoren. Erfahrung mit konkreten QMS-Frameworks oder Systems-Engineering-Methoden (V-Modell, Stage-Gate, APQP o.ä.). Erfahrung im vollständigen Entwicklungszyklus (Konzept → Auslegung → Entwurf → Test → Iteration). Erfahrung bei einem Engineering-Dienstleister oder Innovations-Unternehmen mit breitem Aufgabenspektrum. Druckgeräte -Kenntnisse (Druckgeräterichtlinie 2014/68/EU, Auslegung von Dichtungen und Druckfestigkeit). Versuchsplanung und Messdatenauswertung. Bonus Erfahrung mit thermodynamischen & mathematischen Python-Bibliotheken (TesPy, SymPy, NumPy o.ä.). HVAC- oder Kältetechnik-Wissen. Kunststoff-Lebensdauer (Alterung, Ermüdung, Kriechverhalten von Polymeren unter Last). FEM/CFD-Erfahrung (Nastran, ANSYS, OpenFOAM o.ä.). C++ oder Embedded-Erfahrung. Materialwissenschaft oder Tribologie. Wissenschaftliches Arbeiten (Veröffentlichungen, Forschungsprojekte). Benefits Impact ab Tag 1: In einem Team aus fünf Personen zählt jeder Beitrag. Deine Arbeit fließt direkt in eine Technologie, die den globalen Energieverbrauch senken kann. Kultur ohne Bullshit: Flache Hierarchie, keine Politik, wir achten aufeinander. Wir suchen Menschen, die auch mal Späne zusammenkehren. AI-First-Arbeitsweise: Wir haben eine eigene KI-Agenten-Infrastruktur, Prompt-Bibliotheken und KI-Workflows aufgebaut. Du arbeitest nicht trotz, sondern mit KI als Kernwerkzeug. Flexibilität: Zwei Tage Remote pro Woche möglich, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeit auf Anfrage verhandelbar. Aufgabenvielfalt: Jede Woche sieht anders aus und du hast Freiräume, um dich zu entfalten und weiterzuentwickeln. Gleichzeitig wirst du aber auch nicht mit ungewohnten Aufgaben allein gelassen. Echte Ingenieursarbeit: Keine PowerPoint-Ingenieurskunst. Deine Berechnungen werden gebaut, getestet und gemessen. Du siehst, was du erschaffen hast. Aufstiegschancen: In unserer aktuellen Phase können wir leider keine hohen Gehälter anbieten. Wir glauben jedoch, dass gute Arbeit belohnt werden muss, und arbeiten an einem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungskonzept. Interesse? Schicke uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf per E-Mail und schreibe uns in ein paar Sätzen, warum diese Rolle zu dir passt. Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist nicht notwendig. Wir wollen wissen, wie du denkst und warum du zu uns passt. info@ecalia .de Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Das brauchst du für deine neue Rolle

  • Physik-Fundament: Studium in Maschinenbau, Physik, Energietechnik oder vergleichbar. Du verstehst die Physik hinter den Formeln, kannst neue Zusammenhänge aus physikalischen Konzepten ableiten und das richtige Werkzeug wählen.

Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Kurze Entscheidungswege durch die enge Anbindung an die Geschäftsführung. raw.title: Senior Manager, Digital Marketing & Channel
raw.description:
As a key member of Spire's Growth Marketing and Go-To-Market leadership team, the Senior Director, Digital Marketing & Channels will play a critical role in strengthening and expanding Spire's market position across global Commercial and Government segments. 

This is a hands-on leadership role for a senior digital marketer who combines strategic direction with operational execution. You will set the digital vision, build scalable programs, and personally lead high-impact initiatives across Spire's digital ecosystem. You lead by doing, raising the bar through expertise, speed, and measurable business impact. 

You will own Spire's digital and channel engine end to end, including paid and owned channels, inbound demand generation, website performance, conversion paths, and digital contribution to pipeline. You will directly lead the Social Media & Content Marketing Manager, Video Producer, and Website Lead, ensuring strong alignment across brand, audience engagement, performance marketing, and conversion optimization. 

This role is central to executing Spire's Growth Marketing, Market Activation, Brand, Digital Strategy, and Sales Operations priorities in close partnership with Sales and cross-functional stakeholders. You will ensure digital programs are aligned to company strategy, pipeline goals, and regional go-to-market priorities. 

 

Key responsibilities 

  • Digital Strategy and Channel Leadership: Own the global digital channel strategy across Commercial and Government audiences. Design, execute, and continuously optimize multi-channel programs that engage target buyers and drive awareness, demand capture, conversion, and pipeline growth. 
    This includes: 
    • GEO, SEO and SEM 
    • Paid search and display 
    • Programmatic and retargeting 
    • Social media and digital distribution 
    • Email marketing and nurture programs 
    • Persona-based digital journeys aligned to enterprise and public-sector buying cycles 

  • Hands-On Digital Execution: Act as a player-coach who personally executes critical digital marketing activities while guiding the team toward best-in-class performance. You will be expected to operate with a high level of technical fluency and executional rigor. 
    Core activities include: 
    • Building and optimizing landing pages for campaigns and strategic programs 
    • Managing and improving HubSpot campaigns, workflows, email journeys, and lead scoring 
    • Running paid campaigns across search, display, LinkedIn, and retargeting channels 
    • Driving GEO/SEO improvements, including technical fixes, content structure, and optimization priorities 
    • Creating, testing, and refining nurture journeys and email programs 
    • Running A/B tests across messaging, creative, calls to action, layouts, and conversion paths 
    • Publishing and maintaining digital content in close coordination with Brand and Content 
    • Coaching the team on digital best practices, execution quality, and performance standards

  • Website Performance and Conversion Optimization: Own and continuously improve the global Spire website as a core commercial asset. Ensure the website supports audience engagement, product storytelling, demand generation, and conversion across both Commercial and Government journeys. 
    You will: 
    • Align website UX, structure, and content to digital acquisition and conversion goals 
    • Improve conversion paths and landing page performance 
    • Support launches, campaigns, and strategic initiatives with high-value web experiences 
    • Establish a performance-driven roadmap, prioritization model, and operating cadence for the website 

  • Pipeline Performance and Digital Operations: Own digital contribution to pipeline performance and lead the operational excellence of Spire's digital funnel. Ensure all relevant channels are optimized end to end across awareness, engagement, handoff, and conversion. 
    In partnership with SalesOps and Sales leadership, you will: 
    • Define and monitor the KPIs that matter most for digital performance 
    • Improve demand capture, conversion rates, and funnel efficiency 
    • Strengthen digital measurement, reporting, and insight generation 
    • Help ensure strong alignment between digital programs and follow-up motions across the funnel

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Marketing Activation, Brand, SalesOps, Sales, IT, Compliance, and regional field teams to ensure digital marketing supports the full customer lifecycle, from awareness to conversion to expansion. You will act as the company's subject-matter expert for digital marketing and channels, influencing stakeholders through expertise, credibility, and results. 


Desired Experience and Skills 

We are looking for a senior digital leader who combines strategic thinking with deep hands-on capability. 

Preferred qualifications include: 

  • 8+ years of experience in digital B2B marketing within SaaS, analytics, aerospace, or other technology-driven industries 
  • Proven success building and scaling digital strategies that engage both commercial buyers and governmental audiences 
  • Strong hands-on experience with marketing automation, CRM integration, paid media, analytics, and broader martech ecosystems 
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and optimize websites, improve digital journeys, and drive measurable pipeline impact 
  • Deep analytical capability and a data-driven approach to testing, optimization, and decision-making 
  • Strong people leadership skills, with experience mentoring team members and influencing cross-functional stakeholders 
  • Experience improving demand-to-pipeline workflows and collaborating closely with Sales or SDR teams is a plus 
  • Self-starter mentality, high ownership, and comfort operating in a fast-paced, global environment 
  • Fluency in German and English; additional languages are a plus 


Why Join Spire 

Join Spire on an exciting growth journey and help shape how we communicate, engage, and win across global markets. Your work will directly influence how our space-based data and intelligence solutions are positioned, experienced, and adopted, while strengthening Spire's brand and pipeline performance worldwide. 

#LI-MI1


Global Perks

🛰️ Name Your Satellite Program (NYSP)
🚀 Launch Attendance
🌴 Generous Time Off Policy
🎓 Education Assistance Program
🥰 Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
📈 Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)
👣 Family Leave
💪 Fitness Reimbursement
🧡 Employee Referral Program
🍉 Healthy snacks & beverages in every office

 

About Spire

We improve life on Earth with data from space.

Spire Global is a space-to-cloud analytics company that owns and operates the largest multi-purpose constellation of satellites. Its proprietary data and algorithms provide the most advanced maritime, aviation, and weather tracking in the world. In addition to its constellation, Spire's data infrastructure includes a global ground station network and 24/7 operations that provide real-time global coverage of every point on Earth.


Spire is Global and our success draws upon the diverse viewpoints, skills and experiences of our employees. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

What you'll bring

  • 3–5 years' full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, or a strong track record in an adjacent commercial role (for example SDR) ready to step up.

  • A track record at or near 100% of quota (around £500k–£750k) in at least one of the last two years.

  • Real consultative selling instinct: you'd rather understand a prospect's problem than run a script at them.

  • Comfortable prospecting and selling into accounts with little existing awareness of Cytix, energised by the challenge of a cold or lightly-worked start.

  • Visible drive and competitiveness, and a willingness to take on unfamiliar deal types or buyer personas when asked.

  • Genuinely bright and inquisitive: good follow-up questions come naturally to you, and you're genuinely curious about the product and the security market, including how software gets built and secured.

  • Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you want to take ownership of them and lean in, rather than needing everything mapped out in advance.

  • Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone when a deal or a buyer is unfamiliar territory.

What you'll get

  • Unlimited Holidays!

  • Share options - If Cytix wins, you should too.

  • Enhanced maternity pay.

  • Pension - 8% (3% employer, 5% employee)

  • Private Healthcare (inc. dental, optical and hearing)

  • Octopus car scheme - Drive electric through salary sacrifice

  • Dog-friendly office.

  • Inclusivity as standard - A team where you can do your best work as yourself, no asterisks.

About Cytix

Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.   • Acting as the flexibility team’s first frontend engineer, establish the team’s frontend capability, lead the team’s frontend technical direction and represent the team to the cross-team community of frontend engineers

  • Build and own a diverse range of customer-facing user journeys, enabling customers to onboard, control, and analyse their low carbon tech

  • Build and own internal-facing interfaces for stakeholder-collaborators and experimental prototypes

  • Interface with established mobile teams by providing WebViews for emerging mobile customer journeys 

  • Collaborate with our internal design team to integrate our designs into the wider Octopus design system ‘Coral’

  • Carry out product discovery by working closely with our Product Manager and stakeholders from across the organisation

  • Build highly reusable interfaces that enable rapid response to new opportunities

title: Senior Fire Investigator - Ireland
description: <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Company Overview</strong></p> <p>Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more.</p> <p>Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient.</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together.</p> <p><strong>Job Overview</strong></p> <p>Jensen Hughes is a market leading forensic investigation company, comprised of highly experienced investigators committed to delivering technical excellence.&nbsp; Operating throughout the UK, Ireland and overseas, we investigate the origin and cause of fires and explosions and other accidents or failures on land and at sea. Our clients trust us to respond rapidly and deliver conclusive reports, robust evidence and expert testimony of the highest technical standard in courts throughout the world.</p> <p>A forensic investigation includes establishing the root cause of an event and determining the likelihood of a recovery from a third party or the repudiation of a claim on an insurance policy because the policyholder has failed to fulfil obligations under the contract of insurance.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Fire Investigator to join our highly qualified team, based in Ireland.</p> <p>&nbsp;This role will involve:</p> <ul> <li>Attending incident scenes, documenting and collecting evidence, interviewing witnesses</li> <li>Acting as investigator in the investigation of the origin, cause and development of more complex cases</li> <li>Liaising with experts representing other interested parties</li> <li>Producing consistently high quality, detailed and accurate technical reports</li> <li>Providing expert witness evidence, where required</li> <li>Utilising Jensen Hughes’ case management system to record all case-related activity, in line with SLA requirements</li> <li>Attending joint examinations, utilising the skills of specialists where necessary</li> <li>Maintaining technical knowledge and skills through continuous professional development, by attending training courses, undertaking research and reference to scientific papers and developments in the field of fire and explosion investigation</li> <li>Attending marketing events, as required</li> <li>Produce and present articles/presentations for training or marketing purposes</li> <li>Represent Jensen Hughes at meetings/conferences as an ambassador for the company</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Candidates will have relevant experience and/or qualifications in the field of fire investigation, fire engineering, forensic science or other relevant discipline. Membership to a professional body would be advantageous but is not essential. Regardless of academic/professional background, practical experience is essential.</li> <li>The role requires strong analytical skills and the ability to apply scientific and systematic approaches to the forensic examination of incident scenes.</li> <li>Strong communication skills are essential, along with the ability to present accurate information in a clear and unambiguous manner, both verbally and in writing.&nbsp; Attention to detail, a flexible approach and an ability to form effective working relationships with colleagues and clients are key qualities for this position. You will be expected to be able to work independently with minimal supervision, albeit there will always be a support network of colleagues when assistance or guidance is required.</li> <li>This role requires frequent, often short notice, travel to scenes across Ireland and the UK. Some overseas travel may also be required. You must hold a current driving licence and, ideally, be a car owner.</li> </ul> <p>In return, we offer a competitive salary and performance-related bonus along with other benefits.&nbsp;</p> <p>#LI-MR1</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.</strong></em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate.&nbsp; We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process.&nbsp; Please click <strong><a href="https://www.jensenhughes.com/careers/responsible-use-of-ai-in-the-jensen-hughes-recruitment-process">here</a></strong> to review.</p> <p><br>The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data.&nbsp; Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA.&nbsp; Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>*Policy on use of 3rd party recruiting agency for direct placements<br><br>Jensen Hughes will occasionally augment a recruiting search through agencies for certain positions when business conditions warrant. Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and employees of Jensen Hughes are not authorized to accept resumes, engage in fee-based searches through recruiting firms or sign a search agreement. Please note this policy does not apply to “staffing firms” or firms that are involved with hiring temporary staff. Any recruiting agency interested in being considered may contact our recruiting team at jensenhughesrecruiting.com.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

client expectations.</li> <li>Providing in-house CPD presentations when the need arises in your specialist field.</li> <li>Keeping updated with the latest industry guidance, product literature and overnight stays sometimes required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements and Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree educated in Building Surveying, Fire Safety Management or other similar discipline.</li> <li>Full UK driving licence and access to your own private vehicle.</li> <li>Understanding of fire safety design and guidance for different building types.</li> <li>Experience undertaking fire compartmentation surveys for internal fire stopping installations and advising the contractor based on the relevant manufacturer's literature.</li> <li>The ability to author in depth technical reports utilising the information obtained during the site inspection using both bespoke digital fire protection software and Microsoft Word.</li> <li>The ability to input survey data Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started.

We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in content design or UX writing, with a portfolio that shows work on both sides: copy shipped inside a product, and marketing pages you wrote or restructured

  • Real in-product examples. Onboarding flows, empty states, error messaging, upgrade moments - the words people hit when something is confusing or has gone wrong. Tell us what changed as a result

  • Real web examples. Pages where the copy carries the argument, not just the headline.

  • The ability to look at an already-designed page and say precisely where the message gets lost on a skim, then rewrite it

  • A clear point of view on voice. You can describe a brand's voice and point to copy where you delivered a message in it

  • Comfort working at the pace of a design team that ships daily, in Figma, alongside product designers and PMs rather than downstream of them

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>The Joblogic Story</strong></h3> <p>Established in 1998,&nbsp;<strong>Joblogic</strong> is the UK’s #1 <strong>Field Service Management</strong> (FSM) software platform. Since our management buy-out in 2013, we have grown from <strong>~£500K </strong>ARR to <strong>~£35M+ </strong>ARR and expanded our team from 11 to 500+ people.</p> <p>Recently, we secured a strategic growth investment from <strong>Vista Equity Partners </strong>— a global technology investor specialising in enterprise software. This investment includes over <strong>£100</strong> million in new primary capital and will fuel our next phase of growth by accelerating our <strong>AI-first roadmap</strong>, expanding our platform into CAFM (Computer-Aided Facilities Management) capabilities, and supporting our expansion across Europe and beyond.</p> <p>With <strong>Vista’s </strong>backing, we’re transforming from a successful UK business into a global scaling SaaS rocket ship, and we’d love for you to join us on our journey to <strong>£100M </strong>ARR across international markets.</p> <p><strong>Joblogic </strong>provides software to service contractors who install and maintain the built environment. Our platform helps businesses streamline operations, improve profitability, ensure compliance, and achieve rapid growth. With over <strong>100,000</strong> users across industries including HVAC, plumbing, electrical maintenance, facilities management, and building fabric maintenance, we are entering a new era of intelligent automation, predictive maintenance, and data-driven decision-making for service firms.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <table width="624"> <tbody> <tr> <td width="624"> <p><strong>THIS IS A REAL STEP INTO CLOSING</strong></p> <p>You booked the meeting. Someone else closed it. Not here.</p> <p>Your number. Your accounts. Your calls. Your deals. Start to finish.</p> </td> </tr> </tbody> </table> <h3>You already know this feeling</h3> <p>You worked the account for weeks. You found the pain, you got the right person on the phone, you booked the meeting. Then you handed it over and watched someone else take it to signature and pick up the commission.</p> <p><strong>This is the seat where you keep it.</strong></p> <h3>The role, in plain English</h3> <p>You own a UK and Ireland mid-market patch and carry a monthly new-business ARR target. You find every opportunity yourself, and you close it yourself. There is no SDR underneath you and nobody filling your diary. We give you the data, the tools, the coaching and a few live opportunities to get you moving. Everything after that is yours to build.</p> <p>If that reads as a warning, this is not your role. If it reads as an opportunity, keep going.</p> <h3>What you’ll actually be doing</h3> <ul> <li>Picking your target accounts and going after them properly</li> <li>Cold calling. Every week. Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team. The Team BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next , for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day. We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large. Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it. We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked. The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast. This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer. You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier. Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams. Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone. Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language. Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm. Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions. Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business. What You'll Need to Thrive Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others: Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential. Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar. Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility. A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact. Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view. Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions. Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations. raw.title: GRC Analyst
raw.description:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we're building out our governance, risk and compliance capability with people who enjoy creating structure from scratch and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're building out a dedicated Governance, Risk & Compliance function — moving from a mix of individual ownership and external consultancy support to a resourced team that scales with the business. As GRC Analyst, you'll project manage our compliance programme end-to-end, working alongside a Principal Security Engineer who owns the technical security posture.

This is a builder's role. You won't be inheriting a mature, fully-documented programme — you'll be creating and automating the processes, evidence trails and tracking that don't fully exist yet. You'll have senior guidance close at hand, both internally and through Brookfield's governance frameworks, but you're the one who makes the programme run day to day.

As Radiant's obligations grow — spanning business continuity, AI governance, and an expanding footprint into owned and operated data centre and powered-land infrastructure — this role will grow with them.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end project management of the compliance programme: support ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, manage the policy lifecycle, and handle customer security questionnaires and KYC onboarding

  • Manage data protection operations and training, with UK GDPR at the core

  • Build and continuously improve how we work — automate manual, currently ad hoc processes (evidence collection, policy tracking, questionnaire responses) rather than running them from scratch each time

  • Coordinate business continuity: BCP/DR obligations and ownership of the Major Incident process, including testing and evidencing

  • Support our AI governance work — our internal AI and engineering AI policies — and help us keep pace with a fast-moving regulatory backdrop (including the EU AI Act), covering data handling, human oversight and vendor assessment

  • Coordinate health & safety compliance as we expand into physical premises and data centre operations, helping build a proper H&S management system where none currently exists

  • Partner closely with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, particularly on KYC, Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC) evidence, and technical control documentation

  • Help benchmark and align our Code of Conduct and policies with Brookfield's

  • Contribute to the wider roadmap as our footprint grows: precious and conflict-minerals due diligence, export controls, and ESG/energy governance

What You'll Bring

  • Solid UK GDPR and data protection experience

  • Genuine curiosity about how controls actually work — you're not satisfied when "the box is ticked," you want to understand the journey behind it

  • Hyper-organised — you can run multiple concurrent workstreams (audits, questionnaires, training, policy updates) without anything slipping

  • A builder's mindset — comfortable creating and automating a process from nothing, not just following an existing playbook

  • Autonomous and idea-driven — you'll be directed on priorities, not micromanaged on approach

  • Mid-level compliance/GRC/information security experience — your background does not need to be from AI infrastructure, data centres, or a related industry

  • Confident stakeholder management — you'll work directly with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, not just within a compliance team

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit cycles

  • Exposure to business continuity or major incident processes

  • Familiarity with AI governance or emerging AI regulation

  • Interest in health & safety, environmental/ESG reporting, or physical security and facilities governance

  • Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or equivalent)

Why Join Radiant?

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

  • Real ownership of a function you're building from the ground up, with senior support rather than senior oversight

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry, at the intersection of power, compute and capital

  • Backed by Brookfield — genuine resources, mentorship, and room to grow the role as the company scales

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About the role

This is one of the most important leadership hires in the EMEA business. The Head of KAM — EMEA will own Statista’s most strategically important accounts and lead the team that protects and grows the commercial relationships that underpin our 2026 stability and 2027 acceleration.

You will report directly to the VP Sales EMEA and sit on the EMEA commercial leadership team. This is not a steady-state account management role. It is a transformation mandate — to rebuild the KAM function into an enterprise-grade strategic account motion that moves our most important clients from users of data to institutional partners embedded in Statista’s AI and intelligence infrastructure.

What success looks like - First 12 months

• GRR stabilised across the KAM book through structured renewal discipline, early intervention on at-risk accounts, and a clear early-warning system.

• Every KAM account has a live account plan — org map, stakeholder map, expansion roadmap, and renewal forecast.

• Economic buyer engagement across the top tier — conversations at VP, Director, and C-suite level, not just with research and insights teams.

• Connect adoption initiated in strategically important accounts — from licence conversation to embedded data infrastructure.

• KAM team assessed, coached, and operating to an enterprise standard — structured QBRs, value realisation conversations, and expansion plays running consistently.

• Investment case for FY27 KAM expansion — headcount, coverage model, and tooling — presented to the CCO.

Your tasks

Lead and Transform the KAM Team

• Own the day-to-day leadership, coaching, and performance management of the EMEA KAM team.

• Assess each KAM against the enterprise motion requirements and build individual development plans. Not everyone will be on the same journey — that is a leadership decision, not a management failure.

• Build a coaching standard grounded in enterprise selling: consultative discovery, multi-stakeholder navigation, C-suite engagement, and business case construction.

• Develop the team’s ability to move from user-level relationships to economic buyer access — and to carry a complex, multi-product conversation with credibility.

• Install a peer coaching culture where KAMs learn from each other under a clear standard, not only from you.

Protect GRR in 2026

• Own the renewal and churn-prevention motion across the KAM book.

• Build an early-warning system for at-risk accounts — usage signals, stakeholder changes, competitor activity, budget cycles — with clear escalation and intervention protocols.

• Partner with Customer Success leadership to ensure joined-up coverage across adoption, value realisation, and renewal.

• Conduct and coach structured QBRs that demonstrate ROI and surface expansion signals — not renewal conversations dressed up as business reviews.

Drive the Enterprise Account Motion

• Build and embed the account planning standard across the KAM team — org mapping, stakeholder matrix, commercial roadmap, and expansion sequencing.

• Lead the movement from user-level selling to economic buyer engagement across the top-tier KAM book.

• Own the Connect and Statista+ expansion motion — identifying accounts where data infrastructure conversations are ready to open, and coaching KAMs to run them.

• Build the institutional knowledge that makes Statista’s largest accounts structurally difficult to displace.

Drive NRR Growth

• Own NRR targets across the KAM portfolio. Define the expansion plays that unlock commercial headroom in existing accounts.

• Identify accounts where Connect’s consumption-based model opens a new commercial conversation with a new buyer — technical, commercial, and C-suite.

• Create structured handoffs with the Customer Success and Scale teams to ensure expansion signals are acted on, not lost.

• Champion the full OneStatista platform — core, Connect, Statista+, and IQ roadmap — in every strategic account engagement.

Shape the Commercial Operating Model

• Define the KAM coverage model — which accounts receive full KAM attention, at what intensity, and how that changes as the portfolio evolves.

• Partner with the VP Sales EMEA on the FY27 KAM investment case — headcount, tooling, and the team structure required to operate an enterprise motion at scale.

• Represent EMEA KAM in global commercial leadership forums — bringing regional evidence and recommendations to shape global strategy and playbooks.

• Work closely with New Business leadership to ensure the accounts being landed are the right accounts — and that the handoff from new business to KAM is clean.

Your profile

Essential

• Substantial enterprise account management or key account leadership experience — managing strategic relationships at VP, Director, and C-suite level, with deals at £100k+ ACV.

• Evidence of building or materially improving a KAM or enterprise account function — account planning, coverage models, QBR standards, and expansion playbooks.

• Proven track record of protecting GRR and growing NRR in a subscription-based model.

• Commercial instinct for the enterprise motion — value discovery, business case construction, multi-stakeholder navigation, and land-and-expand execution.

• Experience developing and coaching account managers to raise the quality of their commercial conversations — not just their activity levels.

• Ability to lead change in a team that is transitioning from a transactional to an enterprise model — without losing the team in the process.

Desirable

• Experience in data, intelligence, research, information services, or AI-adjacent platforms.

• Familiarity with consumption-based or usage-based commercial models.

• Exposure to enterprise procurement, legal, and compliance conversations in regulated industries.

• Experience working across multiple European markets in a matrixed organisation.

Why join Statista?

• The most strategically important leadership role in the EMEA commercial organisation. What you build here defines Statista’s growth trajectory.

• Direct line to the VP Sales EMEA and CCO — your commercial judgement will shape decisions at the top of the business.

• A product story that is only getting stronger — Connect, Statista+, and StatistaIQ give you a genuinely differentiated platform to build enterprise relationships around.

• The mandate to rebuild for enterprise — with CEO and board alignment behind the direction. The strategy is set. The opportunity is to execute it.

• Real runway. Build this well in 2026 and you will own the enterprise account engine for one of the most recognised data platforms in the world.

Working Model and Compensation

• Hybrid working from our London office, with regular travel across EMEA and to Hamburg HQ.

• Competitive base salary commensurate with senior enterprise leadership — range shared at initial screen. Above-band compensation considered for exceptional candidates.

• Performance-linked OTE. Pension, private healthcare, and core benefits.

Recruitment Process

Shortlisted candidates will move through a structured process:

• Initial screen with Talent Acquisition.

• In-depth conversation with the VP Sales EMEA.

• Panel interview with CCO and a commercial peer.

• Strategic account plan presentation and live exercise.

Inclusive Application

Statista is committed to building an inclusive workplace and welcomes applications from candidates with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We recognise that strong candidates may not meet every listed criterion. If the role interests you and your experience is relevant, we encourage you to apply. We are happy to discuss reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

     

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

 

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.
